label: Photorealistic cinematic
instructions: Create a live-action cinematic photograph with natural human proportions and physically plausible materials.
Preserve realistic skin texture, fabric behavior, practical lighting falloff and environment scale.
Use restrained color treatment, natural dynamic range and production lighting appropriate to the authored setting.
Allow subtle lens softness, fine sensor noise and mild highlight halation; keep imperfections photographic and unobtrusive.
prohibitions: No illustration, anime, CGI, 3D-rendered or plastic-skin appearance.
No beauty filter, excessive sharpening, artificial bokeh or glossy commercial retouching.
No impossible reflections, duplicated objects, malformed hands or physically unexplained interior weather effects.
